claim: Acceptance 8's RED-when mutation cannot move its stated assertion, because the shipped travel maximiser RESTORES maxTravelRef on the next owned move. CONVERGENT: the critic lane reached this independently, and the lead re-opened the assignment and confirmed it.
evidence: The stated mutation is to make the reorder tracker write maxTravelRef, e.g. by resetting it when the reorder threshold is crossed, and the stated first-moving assertion is the swallow verdict on a Shift-drag past 4 px. The shipped consumer is not a running total that a reset destroys: maxTravelRef.current = Math.max(maxTravelRef.current, Math.hypot(move.clientX - startX, move.clientY - startY)) recomputes against the recording's closure-captured press origin on every owned move. A one-time reset at the 12 px crossing is fully repaired by the very next pointermove of a drag that, by acceptance 53's own fixture, continues past 12 px. At the click the shipped comparison still reads >= 4, the Shift disjunct still fires, and the swallow verdict is unchanged. Acceptance 8's Path audits only what runs BEFORE the mutation's effect; the section-0 rule as written never asks what runs BETWEEN the mutation and the assertion, which is where this one dies. Rounds 3 and 4 added acceptances 49 and 53 to make this mutation EXECUTE; executing was never the problem — surviving to the click is.
impact: S47-2 is the plan's self-declared highest-risk edit and acceptance 8 is the only gate pinning that the widened stream leaves the shipped travel number byte-identical. The plan's own recovery makes it worse: section 0 forbids the lane from restating a non-firing mutation and directs it to mark the row non-discriminating, so the plan's rules route a gateable stop boundary into shipping ungated, and S47-2's failure-behaviour stop loses the instrument that would trigger it. That is a change to acceptance semantics and to a bounded Evidence-Gate path, not a preference.
required_correction: (i) Restate acceptance 8's mutation so nothing between it and the click restores the value — e.g. the reorder consumer assigns maxTravelRef.current = 0 on EVERY move it owns — AND rule the ordering the mutation depends on, which the plan leaves unspecified: inside the shared onTravel, the reorder consumer runs AFTER the travel maximiser, since before it the same mutation is restored within the same event. Alternatively state the fixture clause that the assertion is read after a drag whose threshold crossing is its final owned move. Either way the fixture clause must be written into the criterion. (ii) Extend the section-0 Path rule to cover this direction: a Path must state not only that no earlier predicate short-circuits, but that no statement BETWEEN the mutation and the assertion restores the mutated value.

claim: S47-2's acceptance set assigns gates whose named first-moving assertion is an observable S47-2 does not ship: acceptances 9, 46 and 47 assert a structure POST, and 48, 50 and 52 assert readout text or insertion-line node counts in a layer S47-2 does not create.
evidence: S47-2 is titled 'the arm, the stream, and the click swallow (no paint, no write)' and its Touches list contains neither the reorder layer nor sidecar-bridge.ts nor the release POST. DR47-10 rules that S47-3 ships FULL paint and NO write and that S47-4 wires the write afterwards. Against that, acceptance 9's first-moving assertion is the POST count 0 to 1; 46's is the oid field of the captured request body; 47's is the same shape; 48's is the readout's text; 50's and 52's are insertion-line node counts. S47-2's own Acceptance line reads 1-15, 46-50, 52, 53, and its Verification line makes 46, 50 and 52 the story's must-be-shown-RED set. DR47-14 clause 4 is itself unimplementable in S47-2 for the same reason — it drains a layer S47-3 creates. Acceptance 46 pre-emptively forbids the only substitute available in S47-2, since a tracker or recording count does not discriminate there.
impact: The phase's highest-risk story — the one that splits a shipped control-flow line and is the sole guard against the silent structural write of pre-mortem S7 — would land with all three of its declared safety gates undrivable. The plan's own escape hatch would then let the lane mark exactly those three non-discriminating and commit S47-2 anyway. This is the failure class corrected in each of four rounds, re-entered through story routing rather than fixture wording, and re-routing gates across story boundaries is a lead decision rather than a lane's.
required_correction: Re-route each leg to the story in which its asserted observable exists, or widen the story that owns it — the POST-asserting legs (9, 46, 47) to S47-4, the paint-asserting legs (48, 50, 52) to S47-3 — and restate S47-2's must-be-shown-RED set in terms it can actually drive. Correspondingly move DR47-14 clause 4's implementation to S47-3 and say what, if anything, gates the clause-1 and clause-2 rulings inside S47-2 itself. If instead S47-2 is meant to carry an intercepted release POST and/or a stub layer, write that into its Touches and into DR47-10's ruling, which currently says the opposite.
